clue.text: Ground-breaking dessert wine?

parts.note: afters is British informal for the pudding course
hock is a German white wine, from the Rhine

explanation.surface: A diner asks whether a pudding wine could be called revolutionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ground-breaking' sounds like 'innovative' but is meant literally: the ground breaks in an earth tremor.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor following an earthquake literally breaks up the ground again.

clue.text: Different clue is found for "measures"

indicators.note: different means the letters of 'clue is found' take another order

explanation.surface: A new clue is discovered to mean measures.
explanation.definitionFit: These are units for measuring liquid volume.

clue.text: A star may have one in the train

definitions.text: A star may have one in the train

parts.words: A star may have one in the train
parts.note: a celebrity's train is the retinue following them, not a railway carriage

explanation.surface: A celebrity might be travelling by rail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' suggests a railway; it is a body of followers.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of attendants who accompany a celebrity is a train or retinue.

clue.text: Cry, after seeing native American in school

indicators.note: the native American sits inside the school

parts.note: the Cree are a native American people of Canada

explanation.surface: Someone shouts after meeting a native American pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrill, piercing call is a type of cry.

clue.text: Workers who correspond may be facing anaesthetics

parts.note: opposite means facing
things that numb are numbers, a joke reading

explanation.surface: Colleagues in matching posts face being put under.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anaesthetics' are read as things that numb.
explanation.definitionFit: People holding the equivalent post in another organisation are counterparts.

clue.text: One apparently learned of obstacle after time-wasting hitch, perhaps

indicators.note: after puts the obstacle after the shortened hitch
wasting means the time letter is lost from the hitch

parts.note: a hitch is an example of a knot
a wall is an obstacle

explanation.surface: A scholar hears of a barrier after a delaying snag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apparently' marks that such a person only seems learned.
explanation.definitionFit: A smart alec claims to have learned everything, but the expertise is only apparent.

clue.text: Work with a large stone

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A mason labours on a big block of rock.
explanation.definitionFit: This milky iridescent gem is a precious stone.

clue.text: Groom's about to go into, the holding area

indicators.note: the word for about is to go inside the holding area

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for holding animals
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A bridegroom is ready to enter the waiting area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Groom's' reads as a noun with 's for 'is'; take the verb groom, the 's merely linking.
explanation.definitionFit: To groom oneself carefully, like a bird with its feathers, is to preen.

clue.text: Turner former hotel's acquired

indicators.note: acquired means the word for former takes in the hotel letter

parts.note: late means former, as in the late chairman
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A former hotel has bought a painting by Turner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter J.M.W. Turner; it is a machine that turns wood or metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine for shaping material by rotating it is literally a turner.

clue.text: Flatter product churned out at. university

parts.note: butter is what a churn produces from cream
up means in residence at a university, as in 'up at Oxford'

explanation.surface: Graduates of a college turn out a better-than-average product.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay on compliments to win someone over is a phrasal-verb synonym for flatter.

clue.text: State opposition-to the end

definitions.meaning: to protest or raise a complaint against something
an aim or goal, as in 'the ... of the exercise'

explanation.surface: Someone declares they will resist right up to the finish.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to voice disapproval; as a noun it means a purpose or goal.

clue.text: Cite proof of sources, as doctor — did under chief examiner

indicators.note: the sources of the following words are their opening letters, where each begins

explanation.surface: A doctor gives evidence, as instructed by the senior examiner.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring forward evidence in support of an argument is a formal synonym of citing it.

clue.text: Forage for cold and worried vegan in Kent area

indicators.note: the cold and the worried vegan sit within the Kent area

parts.note: Kent is in south-east England, abbreviated SE
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

indicators.note: worried suggests the letters are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: An anxious vegan in Kent goes searching for food in the cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' makes CAVENG (C plus the anagram AVENG of 'vegan'), which goes between S and E.
explanation.definitionFit: To search around for food or useful scraps is to forage for them.

clue.text: Old club may support smarmy diner, by the way

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting club sits below the smarmy word

parts.note: greasy can mean smarmy, ingratiating
a spoon is an old name for a wooden golf club

explanation.surface: A traditional society might back an oily roadside restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old club' is not a society: spoon is an obsolete golf club.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheap roadside café serving fried food is a humble diner by the road.

clue.text: Player having a bath first

indicators.note: first says the bath comes before the letter A in the answer

parts.note: a tub is a bath

explanation.surface: A musician insists on having a soak before performing.
explanation.definitionFit: This large brass instrument is played, and a player can mean an instrument as well as its musician.

clue.text: Passionate, or half-hearted warning initiated?

indicators.note: half of the double-letter heart of the word for a warning is lost

parts.note: a hoot from a horn is a warning
blooded means initiated, given a first taste of something

explanation.surface: A fiery person is contrasted with someone who issues a feeble caution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-hearted' removes one of the two middle Os of HOOT, leaving HOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ardent and easily roused is a fiery, passionate sort.

clue.text: Needing to be rescued from hitting the drink

definitions.text: Needing to be rescued from hitting the drink

parts.words: Needing to be rescued from hitting the drink
parts.note: the drink is slang for the sea, so this is someone who has fallen off a ship, not a heavy drinker

explanation.surface: An alcoholic needs saving from booze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hitting the drink' suggests heavy drinking; the drink is the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling over the side of a ship into the sea is going over the side.

clue.text: Ability to tolerate possible reply to wedding invitation

definitions.meaning: willingness to put up with something
a formal note saying you will attend

explanation.surface: Being gracious includes how you answer a wedding card.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both tolerance of something and a formal yes to an invitation.

clue.text: If they're in, one could well be last out

definitions.text: If they're in, one could well be last out

parts.words: If they're in, one could well be last out
parts.note: in cricket the weakest batsmen bat at the end of the order, so when they are batting the innings is nearly over

explanation.surface: A remark about who leaves last.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the lower-order batsmen are the weak hitters who come in last; 'in' and 'out' are batting terms.
explanation.definitionFit: The bottom of the batting order in cricket, where the weakest batsmen bat, is this part of the team.

clue.text: Display stand seen to be French? About time

indicators.note: about means the French verb goes around the time

parts.note: etre is French for to be
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A shelf unit is judged to be French, and not before time.
explanation.definitionFit: This French word names a set of open shelves for displaying ornaments.

clue.text: Relax, when double dose of drug is around

indicators.note: around means the doubled drug surrounds the word for when
the drug's letter is given twice

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Someone is told to calm down after taking a double dose of medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease off is to slacken or relax.

clue.text: Dunce's cap is meant to provide a break from reality

indicators.note: the run of letters is supplied from within the words 'Dunce's cap is meant'

explanation.surface: A dunce's cap is said to give a child relief from the real world.
explanation.definitionFit: Escaping into fantasy to avoid unpleasant reality is what the word names.

clue.text: Student assessments are found in old manuscript

indicators.note: the word for are is found inside the old manuscript

parts.note: ex means former, old
an are is a metric unit of area, abbreviated A

explanation.surface: Tests on students are discovered in an ancient document.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal tests of what students have learned are assessments.

clue.text: Manage to conceal source of sound in some trees

indicators.note: the word for manage is to hide the source letter within it

parts.note: to cope is to manage

indicators.note: the source of sound is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone tries to hide the origin of a noise among the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A small clump of trees growing together is a thicket or copse.

clue.text: Trap set in the outback by a military leader

indicators.note: the leader of military is its opening letter

parts.note: the bush is the Australian outback

explanation.surface: An army commander lays a trap in the Australian wilderness.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie in wait and attack by surprise is a military trap.

clue.text: First of people appearing in a father's dream

indicators.note: the first of people appears inside the word for father

parts.note: a sire is a father, especially of an animal

indicators.note: the first of people is its opening letter

explanation.surface: People feature first in what a father hopes for.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire is to dream of achieving something, as a verb.

clue.text: It's central to many an American story

definitions.text: It's central to many an American story

parts.words: It's central to many an American story
parts.note: a story is a floor of a building, and the American lift runs up the core of many buildings

explanation.surface: Something lies at the heart of many tales from the US.
explanation.walkthrough: 'story' looks like a tale but is the American spelling of storey, a floor of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the American word for a lift, which usually sits at the core of a building and links its storeys.

clue.text: Come out slowly, rather — inclined to lose time

indicators.note: the sloping word has to lose a letter

parts.note: steep means sharply sloping, rather inclined

explanation.surface: Someone prepared to lose time is in no hurry to emerge.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid that oozes out gradually is said to seep.

clue.text: Line up starts at one

parts.note: trace a family line upwards and it starts at an ancestor, with this person at its other end

explanation.surface: Queue-forming begins at a particular person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Line up' looks like queueing; it is a family line traced up to its source.
explanation.definitionFit: An offspring further down a family tree is one whose ancestry, traced back, begins with an ancestor.
